extracted.name: Cilantro Lime Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: This refreshing cucumber cilantro salad, flavored with lime juice, is quick and easy to make and is great alongside steak or tacos.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix cucumber, cilantro, lime juice, garlic, sambal oelek, red pepper flakes, and salt together in a bowl until evenly combined; allow to sit until flavors blend, at least 10 minutes.
